1.Title: Pumpkin Genie
1.Des: Pull the pumpkin into the allied side of the battlefield to light up the Jack-o'-Lantern.

2.Title: Pumpkin Rescue
2.Des: The pumpkin is headed for the Death Center! Stun it!

3.Title: Pumpkin Rising
3.Des: Kick pumpkins out of the battlefield.

4.Title: Pumpkin Masterchef
4.Des: Required steps for every pumpkin recipe: physical damage, stun, transform—and the faster, the better!

5.Title: Pumpkin Sprint
5.Des: Evil pumpkins are sprouting up everywhere. Destroy them!

6.Title: Pumpkin Revival
6.Des: The pumpkin is under attack from an unknown source. Use healing or shields to help it hold out.

7.Title: Pumpkin Unmatched
7.Des: There's only 1 real pumpkin. Inflict 3 strikes of health loss to eliminate impostors!

8.Title: Moonlit Pumpkin
8.Des: The pumpkin becomes enraged periodically. Use an Ultimate to calm it down!
